alignments.note: Causal conjunction; the ASV fronts the postpositive γάρ as the verse-opening 'for'.
Inflected verb takes its supplied English subject as a rule 7/9 helper; rule 9 heads on the lexical verb 'beholdeth' rather than on 'he'.
Expressed conjunction aligned in the ordinary way.

ἀπέρχομαι is glossed 'go away'; 'away' is the verb's own particle within that gloss, not an English preposition governing a phrase, so rule 36 does not bear on it and both words stay with the verb, headed on 'goeth'.
Second expressed conjunction to the second 'and'; rule 2 keeps it separate from the adverb it precedes.
Finite verb to 'forgetteth'; English carries the subject over from the preceding clause and writes no pronoun here, so nothing rides with this verb.

The correlative adjective *of what sort* is rendered by the whole frame *what manner of man*. Rule 91 makes the head the word the corpus already spends on this lexeme, and the corpus is unbroken: every interrogative or correlative adjective the ASV expands with *manner of* heads on *what* — 2PE.3.11 `ποταποὺς` → *what manner of persons*, the exact structural twin, and 1PE.1.11 `ποῖον`, JHN.12.33 and JHN.21.19 `ποίῳ`, JHN.18.32, 1JN.3.1 `ποταπήν` — six units on *what* and none on *manner*; `ὁποῖος` itself heads on the *what-* word at GAL.2.6, `ὁποῖοί` → *whatsoever*. *manner of man* is the frame and its generic completion, as *manner of persons* is at 2PE.3.11. Heading on *man* as the phrase's formal English noun is refused by rule 17, and heading on *manner* would rest on decomposing the Greek — that `ὁποῖος` adds a sortal element over a bare `τίς` — which is exactly the compositional argument rule 91 replaces with the query on the lemma. Rules 84 and 91 make an unbroken corpus a settled head, so this is not a rule 16 hedging case.

Expressed copula with its supplied subject pronoun as a rule 7 helper, headed on the verb 'was' under rule 9. Rule 53 is not in question: the Greek expresses the copula, so nothing is supplied for a predicate to carry.

review_notes: Reviewed unchanged. All ten source IDs and all sixteen target IDs are partitioned exactly once; every unit is aligned, with no unrepresented, added or noncompositional units in this verse.
The only materially contested head is s009: 'manner' over 'man' and over 'what', argued in the unit note under rules 17 and 66.
'away' is kept with ἀπελήλυθεν rather than split off as a stranded particle: no Greek preposition stands separately in the clause for rule 36 to bear on, and 'go away' is the lexeme's own gloss.
κατενόησεν and ἦν each take their own supplied subject pronoun under rules 7 and 9, while ἐπελάθετο takes none, the ASV writing no pronoun for it.
Note wording on s005, s008, s009 and s010 expanded to name the rules ruled out; the units, statuses and heads are as accepted.
